### 07:53:39 KST

Commander-mode batch confirmed a reproducible Zerg failure: over-drones + banks gas it can't spend (gas rose 1200->1598 while under attack) + thin army -> rolled by Terran bio+siege timings, two games running. Root cause = larva contention (drones and army both morph from larvae; gas-flood valve can't convert with no larva left). Fix: gate Zerg drone production when economy is functional (44+ drones) and gas banks (>=500) so larvae flow to army. Deployed test-gated (337 tests pass, +4). LLM+commander loop validated end-to-end across all 3 races + many full games; cheatmoney too hard (1W-7L, demote pending).

**Git** (main @ `f5c874a`) — 1 new commit(s) since last checkpoint:
- `f5c874a` Zerg: gate drone production when gas banks (larva contention fix)
_(working tree: clean)_

### 11:36:22 KST

Fixed the #1 recurring loss cause (T/P gas flood, seen every Protoss game all session): 1200+ gas floods while army stays thin -> timing crushes us. Two gaps: _absorb_gas_flood bailed if any light gas unit (stalker 50/marauder 25) was in the mix (can't drain 1200); _auto_scale_production never scaled on a gas bank so robo/factory throughput stayed flat. Fix: hard flood (>=1000) forces the HEAVY sink (immortal/siegetank) past light units; _auto_scale_production now triggers on gas>=800 and scales the heavy gas unit's producer (robo/factory), base-capped. The T/P analog of the validated Zerg drone-gate. Deployed, 344 tests pass.
